title: Art Director
description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The AI Art Director sits within Creative Studio and helps define and advance the quality of AI-powered creative across StackAdapt. This is a senior, hands-on creative role for someone who combines exceptional creative judgment with deep experience in visual storytelling, filmmaking, creative production, and generative AI.

You will explore emerging creative technologies, develop high-quality creative approaches and workflows, and help establish what great AI-powered advertising looks like. The role combines creative direction with hands-on experimentation and close collaboration across creative and technical teams.

As generative technology evolves, so will this role. We're looking for someone who is excited by emerging creative possibilities, can move fluidly between creative direction and experimentation, and enjoys turning what they learn into practices and knowledge that make the broader team better.

StackAdapt is a remote first company. 

What You'll Be Doing:

• Establish and continually raise the creative quality bar for AI-generated advertising.

• Apply deep creative expertise across concept development, visual storytelling, composition, lighting, movement, pacing, colour, editing, and sound.

• Create high-quality concepts, prototypes, and reference work using emerging generative technologies.

• Work hands-on with leading generative image and video technologies to design, test, and refine creative workflows, including prompting, model selection, reference techniques, and methods for improving quality and consistency.

• Translate creative judgment and experimentation into reusable creative principles, frameworks, workflows, and best practices.

• Develop standards and evaluation methods for assessing AI-generated creative quality, identifying recurring failure patterns, and recommending improvements.

• Evaluate emerging AI models, tools, and creative technologies to determine where they can improve creative quality, efficiency, or unlock new creative possibilities.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Creative Strategy, Production, Product, Engineering, and Data Science to advance the quality and capabilities of AI-powered creative.

• Develop the AI capabilities of other Creative Studio team members through coaching, knowledge sharing, documentation, and hands-on collaboration.

• Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Creative Studio by identifying new opportunities for AI to improve how advertising creative is conceived, produced, and evaluated

What You'll Bring to the Table

• Significant professional experience in creative direction, art direction, filmmaking, cinematography, advertising, or a related creative discipline, with a strong portfolio of work.

• Strong expertise in visual storytelling and filmmaking fundamentals, including composition, lighting, camera movement, pacing, editing, and narrative structure.

• Hands-on experience producing high-quality creative with generative AI image and video technologies.

• Experience developing sophisticated AI creative workflows; familiarity with node-based workflow environments such as ComfyUI, Weavy, or similar systems is strongly preferred.

• Strong prompt engineering skills and an understanding of how prompting, reference inputs, model selection, and workflow design influence creative output.

• Excellent creative judgment, with the ability to articulate why creative work succeeds or falls short and provide clear direction for improvement.

title: Personal Finance Editor
description:
The Personal Finance Editor shapes and refines Money ’s award- winning personal finance content, splitting time between editing (60%) and original writing (40%). Sitting in the department that handles sponsored content requests, this role combines strong editorial judgment and writing skills with an understanding of how content supports audience and business goals. The ideal candidate has experience creating high-quality content for a publisher, agency, or in-house brand team and can work effectively across editorial, business, and external partners.
Success looks like accurate, engaging content that serves readers, maintains Money ’s editorial standards, supports business objectives, and performs well across traditional search and AI-powered discovery platforms.
Responsibilities:

• Shape content strategies that balance audience needs, editorial integrity and sponsor goals.

• Edit articles, guides, and other personal finance content for clarity, accuracy, tone, and adherence to Money ’s editorial standards and sponsor objectives.

• Work directly with internal and external teams to move projects efficiently from brief through publication.

• Write original content covering personal finance topics, translating sponsor goals and product details into engaging, accurate copy.

• Optimize content for discoverability across both traditional search engines, such as Google, and generative AI search and answer engines, such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

• Fact-check financial claims, statistics, and product details to ensure accuracy and compliance with relevant financial regulations and disclosure requirements.

• Manage content timelines and prioritize a mix of editing and writing assignments to meet publishing deadlines.

• Stay current on personal finance trends, search behavior, and AI search developments to inform content strategy.

• Provide feedback and editorial guidance to freelance writers and contributors as needed.

• Among other responsibilities related to the business unit and the position.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional editing and/or writing experience, ideally in a media, publishing, content marketing, or agency environment.

• Strong command of grammar, style and editorial best practices; working knowledge of personal finance topics such as credit, banking, loans, insurance, and investing; strong understanding of how content is discovered across search engines and AI-driven answer engines, including Google, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity; and the ability to balance a workload of roughly 60% editing and 40% writing across multiple projects simultaneously.

• Certifications: None required.

What We Offer
This is a full-time remote position and is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k), and paid leave, among others.
This job's annual salary range is $80,000.00 - $100,000.00
The offered salary may vary within the posted range based on factors including, but not limited to, education, skills, experience, training, job responsibilities, and location. Applicants must be available to work Eastern Time hours. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We do not currently sponsor or transfer employment visas.
Money Publishing Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

This function looks across the portfolio over time - tracking performance against investor and bank partner thresholds, interpreting model execution patterns, identifying systemic risk, and escalating findings before they become repurchase events, partner concerns, or examination issues.
As the Senior Manager, Whole Loan Trading & First-Line Model Governance at Upstart , you will own this function end-to-end, reporting directly to the Head of Secured Lending. You will lead a small team of analysts and partner closely with Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Model Risk Management, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and bank partners to establish the methodology, monitoring cadence, governance materials, and reporting routines that keep Upstart ’s secured lending portfolio within risk appetite and exam-ready.

• Monitor portfolio-level salability risk across secured lending channels - tracking eligibility adherence trends, defect patterns, collateral documentation quality, and exception concentrations; escalate repurchase and put-back risk to Capital Markets and bank partners before they affect loan sale execution or partner commitments.

• Monitor asset quality and portfolio performance indicators tied to salability, including early payment defaults, delinquency, loss severity, prepayment, non-performing loan trends, exception patterns, and threshold breaches.

• Evaluate origination and channel quality across secured lending programs, including collateral documentation completeness, lien perfection, override

This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

As a multi-bank deposit marketplace supporting high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and a centralized cash account, Raisin facilitates inbound and outbound ACH transactions, reinvestments, and internal money movement across partner banks, custodial banks, and service bank relationships.

title: Underwriting Assistant
description:
Description
Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.
We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel. We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.
Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.
At Ledgebrook , everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star-fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages-we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook ’s success.
About the Role
Ledgebrook is seeking experienced E&S Underwriting Assistant who has experience supporting Inland Marine, Builder's Risk, or Property talent to join our growing team, whose mission is to build a profitable book of E&S business across expanding lines of business and coverages. Ledgebrook ’s vision is to deliver market-relevant solutions to our key wholesale trading partners in a more frictionless environment that places an emphasis on efficiencies and quality to meet or exceed our broker’s overall needs in a risk-differentiated manner. If you possess an entrepreneurial passion with a proven track history of delivering high-quality underwriting support and seek an opportunity to break out of the traditional insurance company mold, we’re looking for you!
As a member of the Ledgebrook Underwriting Support team, you will regularly interact with Ledgebrook ’s underwriters and wholesale trading partners over the phone, virtually, or in-person to facilitate various transactions independently or with limited guidance. We are looking for candidates with a strong overall E&S support background across various lines of business, including a curiosity to gain a deeper knowledge of our business.
We currently operate in a fully remote work environment, so we’re more focused on your experience and cultural fit than where you physically sit!
About you
We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.
You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

• A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.

• Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.

• Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.

• A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.

• Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.

• A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame-you immediately focus on how to fix it.

• Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.

• Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements
As a future Ledgebrook E&S Underwriting Assistant, your experience and qualifications should include:

• Prior general/technical E&S underwriting support experience across various lines of business and coverages.

• Experience in submission process management

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Bratislava, Slovakia
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Sr Integration Developer - (Java e Spring boot) - COM INGLÊS - Remoto
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO 

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 40 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor de Integração experiente para projetar e implementar integrações corporativas para um programa de Modernização de Automação em larga escala no setor de Energia. A função será responsável pelo desenvolvimento dos microsserviços corporativos para realizar a conexão entre múltiplas plataformas de negócio, incluindo Portal do Cliente, CRM, Faturamento, Precificação, Previsão, Gateways de Pagamento, Utilities, Microsoft Fabric e outras plataformas SaaS. O candidato selecionado trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o Líder de Integração, Arquitetos de Soluções, Analistas de Negócios, Arquitetos de Dados e fornecedores externos para entregar integrações seguras, escaláveis, resilientes e reutilizáveis, utilizando os Serviços de Integração do Azure e serviços Java Spring Boot.

Visão Geral do Projeto: O programa de Modernização de Automação tem como objetivo modernizar o ecossistema da organização nas áreas de clientes, precificação, previsão, faturamento e analytics por meio de integrações API-first, nativas da nuvem e orientadas a eventos no Microsoft Azure.

Principais Responsabilidades:
• Projetar e desenvolver integrações corporativas utilizando Azure Integration Services e Java Spring Boot.
• Desenvolver APIs RESTful e microsserviços utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
• Desenvolver e configurar APIs utilizando Azure API Management (APIM).
• Implementar padrões de integração síncronos e assíncronos com base nos requisitos da solução.
• Desenvolver integrações de mensageria e orientadas a eventos utilizando Azure Service Bus, filas, tópicos, assinaturas e serviços relacionados do Azure.
• Implementar integrações entre aplicações corporativas, plataformas SaaS, bancos de dados, parceiros externos e serviços do Microsoft Azure.
• Implementar transformação, validação, roteamento e orquestração de mensagens, tratamento de exceções e mecanismos de retry.
• Desenvolver componentes e serviços de integração reutilizáveis e alinhados aos padrões corporativos de integração.
• Implementar autenticação e autorização de APIs utilizando Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, JWT, Managed Identities e mecanismos de segurança relacionados.
• Proteger credenciais de aplicações, segredos, certificados e informações de conexão utilizando Azure Key Vault.
• Implementar logging, monitoramento, rastreamento distribuído, correlation IDs e telemetria operacional para serviços de integração.
• Desenvolver testes unitários, testes automatizados de APIs e testes de integração.

Qualificações Obrigatórias:

• Inglês avançado/fluente - mandatório ( será avaliado em entrevista)
• Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e integração corporativa.
• Sólida experiência prática de desenvolvimento com Java e Spring Boot.
• Sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microsserviços.
• Experiência prática com Azure API Management (APIM).
• Experiência com Azure Service Bus, incluindo filas, tópicos, assinaturas e processamento de mensagens.
• Sólido entendimento de padrões de integração síncronos, assíncronos, de mensageria e orientados a eventos.
• Experiência com JSON, REST, HTTP/HTTPS, OAuth 2.0, JWT e segurança de APIs.
• Experiência na implementação de tratamento de exceções, mecanismos de retry, processamento de dead-letter, logging e monitoramento.

Qualificações Desejáveis:
• Experiência com serviços adicionais do Azure Integration Services, como Logic Apps, Event Grid, Event Hubs e Azure Functions.
• Experiência na integração de plataformas SaaS e corporativas, incluindo CRM, faturamento, pagamentos, precificação, previsão e plataformas de dados.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. - Define and evolve the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s LiDAR and cross-sensor 3D sensing capabilities, aligned with product and vehicle-programme requirements.

- Lead the development of target-based and targetless LiDAR calibration and registration methods, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment using geometric and learned approaches.

- Develop robust temporal alignment and motion compensation methods using techniques such as LiDAR odometry, nonlinear least-squares optimisation and factor graphs.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for shaping the architecture and technical roadmap for 3D sensing, while remaining deeply involved in algorithm development, implementation, evaluation and deployment. You will solve challenging problems arising from real sensor systems-including imperfect time synchronisation, rolling-shutter cameras and LiDAR sweep patterns-and develop robust methods that operate across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions. You will collaborate broadly across Wayve and provide technical leadership and mentorship across the 3D sensing stack.

- Strong experience with target-based or targetless sensor calibration and registration, including LiDAR-to-camera alignment.

- Strong understanding of 3D geometry, state estimation and optimisation techniques, including nonlinear least-squares methods or factor graphs.

- Strong software-engineering skills in C++ and/or Python, with experience taking robotics algorithms from prototype through evaluation and production deployment.

- Experience defining evaluation methodologies, datasets and metrics for assessing calibration, registration and 3D sensing quality across real-world conditions.

- Demonstrated technical leadership, including setting technical direction, solving ambiguous cross-functional problems and mentoring other engineers.

Desirable

- Experience with metric-depth foundation models and their application to calibration, registration or 3D reconstruction.

title: FinOps Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

What You'll Be Responsible For

In this role, you'll:

- Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP: Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

- Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline: Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on.

- Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models: Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online.

- Apply data science to cost and usage data: Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match.

- Build and maintain cost attribution: Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

- Automate cost governance: Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

- Partner with engineering on architecture decisions: Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

- Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting: Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

- Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

- Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing).

- Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb.

- Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash.

- Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

- Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

- Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

- Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to bot

title: Principal Architect
description:
Category: Computer

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Engineer with a strong background in Apache Solr and Java to lead our engineering and customer-led initiatives .
The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our search platform while providing expert-level troubleshooting and resolution for critical production issues .
This role will involve designing the architecture for new platforms while reviewing and recommending improved approaches for existing systems to drive continuous improvement and efficiency .

Responsibilities

• Lead engineering and support activities for Solr-based search applications , ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance .

• Design and develop the architecture of new platforms , while reviewing and recommending better approaches for existing platforms .

• Continuously enhance search ranking, query understanding, and retrieval effectiveness .

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues in Solr, Java-based applications, and supporting infrastructure.

• Perform deep-dive analysis of logs, performance metrics, and alerts to proactively identify and prevent incidents.

• Optimize Solr indexes, queries, and configurations to improve search performance and system reliability .

• Work closely with development, operations, and business teams to drive improvements in system stability and operational efficiency .

• Implement monitoring tools, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms to enhance observability and proactive issue detection .

•
Work with AI-powered search technologies , including:

• Vector databases

• RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) models

• NLP techniques

• LLM-based search enhancements

• Collaborate on capacity planning, system scaling, and disaster recovery strategies for mission-critical search systems .

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in software development and production support, with a focus on Apache Solr, Java, and databases such as Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL .

• Strong understanding of Solr indexing, query execution, schema design, configuration, and performance tuning .

• Experience in designing and implementing scalable system architectures for search platforms.

• Proven ability to review and assess existing platform architectures , identify areas for improvement, and recommend optimized architectural approaches .

• Proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture .

• Experience working with Linux/Unix-based environments , including shell scripting and production system debugging .

•
Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools , such as:

• Prometheus

• Grafana

• Splunk

• ELK Stack

• Expertise in troubleshooting performance issues , including Solr optimization, JVM tuning, and memory management .

• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP , along with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced environments .

• Certifications in Solr, Java, or cloud technologies are a plus.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership abilities .

Benefits

• Competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefits package .

• Opportunities for professional development , continuous learning, and training programs.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work environment that encourages knowledge sharing and growth.

• Access to health and wellness programs to support employee well-being.

A Mgr, Product is a product leader responsible for defining strategy, driving outcomes, and developing product talent for one or more complex engineering platforms. In this player-coach role, the Manager, Product combines deep product management expertise with people leadership to help teams build scalable, self-service capabilities that improve how engineers build, deliver, secure, and operate software across Thrivent.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery, but by improving developer experience, reducing cognitive load, simplifying software delivery, and enabling teams to operate independently through well-designed product experiences and paved-road solutions.

This leader partners closely with Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders across the enterprise to identify systemic challenges, understand customer needs, and translate those insights into product strategy and execution plans. Since 1986, Brax, a Ferguson company, has been one of California’s leading pump and process equipment companies, serving municipal and industrial customers across the state. As part of Ferguson , a Fortune 500 company that has supplied a wide range of industries since 1953, we share a simple purpose: to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes, and better businesses. With approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations, Ferguson is a community of people building something meaningful, and a place to build a career you’re proud of at a company you can believe in.
Brax is looking for a Business Development Manager to grow our industrial and municipal projects business across Southern California, Southern Nevada, and Hawaii, with the potential to take on the entire West Coast. You’ll build relationships with current and prospective customers, manage existing business, and open new accounts.

This role is fully remote. Candidates must be based in the Pacific Time Zone (West Coast) and able to work standard business hours in that time zone.
Responsibilities:

• Achieve sales growth and targets in the pumps and process equipment market, both through direct account management and through the sales representatives assigned to the market.

• Develop and execute a strategic business plan that expands the company’s customer base and strengthens its presence in the market.

• Recruit, set objectives for, coach and monitor the performance of the team assigned to the projects group.

• Build strong, long-term relationships with cities, water and wastewater agencies, consulting engineers, and contractors by understanding their needs and partnering with them on solutions.

• Work with consulting engineers and public agencies to get the pumps and equipment Brax represents included in project specifications and approved-product lists.

• Track projects from planning and design through bid and award and coordinate quotes and submittals with internal teams.

• Partner with the manufacturers Brax represents on joint sales calls, product training, and project pursuits.

• Present sales, revenue and expense reports and realistic forecasts to the management team.

• Monitor emerging markets, market shifts, new pump and treatment technologies and competitor activity.

Experience/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of outside sales or business development experience, preferably selling pumps or related equipment into the municipal water and wastewater market.

• Experience leading, coaching or mentoring sales representatives preferred.

• Working knowledge of pump applications and systems, such as lift stations, booster stations and treatment plants.

• Working knowledge of the public bid process, project specifications and the role of consulting engineers.

• Proven record of meeting sales targets and growing a territory.

• Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office.

description:

You Will Bring:

• 5-12+ years of engineering experience

• Experience designing evaluation, experimentation, benchmarking, or measurement systems for AI, search, developer platforms, or other complex distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of modern LLMs, AI agents, and the engineering systems required to deploy them effectively.

• Experience building systems that optimize across multiple dimensions, including quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Excellent software engineering fundamentals and a passion for building production-quality systems.

• Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and drive technical direction for highly strategic initiatives.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and experience working across engineering, infrastructure, and platform organizations.

title: Független Értékesítő - Dombóvár
description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

- Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

- Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre,

title: Senior Brand Manager - Beauty - AMAZON
description:
Senior Brand Manager - Beauty
ABOUT NEATO
Neato is a 2P eCommerce accelerator based in Las Vegas. We buy inventory from established brands and operate as their exclusive online retailer across every major channel - Amazon, TikTok Shop, DTC, and Walmart - all fulfilled from a single inventory pool. Unlike agencies that get paid whether you grow or not, we make money when we sell your product. When we don't, we eat it. Every decision we make is backed by our own capital.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Senior Brand Manager owns the profit and loss of a beauty portfolio inside that model. You are the one person accountable for contribution margin - the number that says whether the brand is worth Neato 's capital every week. You set the price, protect the buy box, keep the shelves in stock, run the promotional calendar, chase the reimbursements, and answer for the result.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
✓ Availability - in-stock rate on every ASIN, every day. You set the reorder cadence with Supply Chain and own stockouts before they happen.
✓ Price & margin - every price on every channel. Buy box protection. MAP enforcement. Margin defense when algorithms move against you.
✓ Merchandising, assortment, conversion - detail pages, A+ content, video, imagery, reviews, variations. Anything a shopper sees is your surface.
✓ Profit recovery - billbacks, reimbursements, chargebacks, shortage claims. Money left on the table is money you're accountable for.
✓ Marketplace control - unauthorized sellers, MAP violators, counterfeits. You quarterback the enforcement plan with Legal and the brand.
✓ Demand generation - ad strategy, Vine, PPC, DSP, external traffic. You set the plan; the Ads team executes; you own the ROAS.
✓ Promotion & subscription - promo calendar, deal cadence, Subscribe & Save base growth. Every promo has a P&L before it runs.
✓ Brand partnership - you are the face Neato shows the brand. Weekly reviews, quarterly strategy, joint planning. When the brand escalates, they call you first.
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
✓ Portfolio contribution margin - trend and absolute.
✓ In-stock rate - across the assortment.
✓ Buy box ownership rate - on 1P and 3P.
✓ Subscribe & Save base growth - month over month.
✓ Reimbursement dollars recovered - against opportunity.
✓ Brand partner NPS - they renew or they don't.
WHAT YOU BRING
✓ 7-10+ years operating a beauty CPG brand's P&L - direct Amazon 1P and 3P operating experience, not agency-adjacent.
✓ Weekly numbers cadence - you read the P&L to peers every week without notes.
✓ Reimbursement fluency - you know what Amazon owes you and how to collect it.
✓ MAP enforcement experience - across marketplaces.
✓ Contribution-margin literacy - you can defend a promo or a price change to a CFO.
✓ Bias to action - over meetings and decks.
NICE TO HAVE
★ TikTok Shop, DTC, Walmart - hands-on experience, or fast to learn.
WHY YOU'LL WANT THIS
This is a true P&L seat, not a coordination role - you set price, own the promo calendar, and answer directly for contribution margin, with performance-linked upside tied to the result. You partner daily with Supply Chain, Creative, Ads, and Finance, and you're the person the brand calls first when it matters.

Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

•
Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.

•
Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.

•
Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.

•
Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns : interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.

•
Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.

•
Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.

•
Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.

•
Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

• You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.

• You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.

• You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

- Evolve tutor quality standards and guardrails that protect quality and fairness across B2B and NLS

- Define success metrics and build dashboards for supply health with Data (e.g., liquidity and coverage, funnel health, tutor CSAT, problematic lessons)

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

- Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

- Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

- Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

- Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

- Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

- Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

- Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise.

- Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics.

- Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

MUST-HAVES

- Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions.

- Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had.

- Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis.

- A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief.

- Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why.

- Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations.

ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE TEAM

Nu's Finance organization is structured into functional areas that together safeguard financial stability, compliance and strategic decision-making. Most core finance functions operate under a dual reporting structure - reporting directly into the global Finance team, with a dotted line to the business they support - which keeps us close to the operation while holding a consistent global standard.

Within Finance, FP&A owns budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning, and acts as the analytical partner behind the company's biggest decisions. The team drives profitable growth by improving visibility, forecasting quality, consolidation and analysis of results and key metrics, translating them into insights and recommended actions for senior management. It also defines the performance metrics that create accountability and ownership across FP&A and the business units - tracking them consistently to measure progress, monitor KPIs and drive cost optimization.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Head of Credit Products FP&A to be the finance owner for Nu's consumer and small business credit businesses across all markets - Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, the United States, and the geographies we enter next. Credit is the engine that powers Nubank's economics, and this role is the person leadership turns to when the question is how that engine actually behaves: what drives revenue, what drives losses, and how the two reconcile into a single view of each product.

The scope covers every credit product we offer, including credit card, personal loans, and other lending products, and it will grow as Nu launches new products and enters new markets. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and consistent exposure to senior leadership, including the executives who run these businesses. You will be expected to hold a position when the analysis supports it, push back with evidence, and take direct feedback.

This role is about building as Nubank grows including reengineering how we model and forecast our credit businesses, starting with the economics of a single customer and building up to the portfolio P&L. You will also own the position Finance takes on those numbers with the Management Team. Doing that credibly requires deep, hands-on expertise in consumer credit: how portfolios originate, season, revolve, and lose money, and how pricing, underwriting, and funding decisions flow through to the P&L. Experience in Brazil, our largest market, is a plus.

You will lead a team of 15-20 finance professionals, set the standard for their work, and develop a deep talent pool, while staying close enough to the models and the data to challenge them on substance.

You’ll be Responsible for

 

- Own the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Credit Card and Lending across all markets, with full accountability for the integrity of the numbers and for the position Finance takes on them with leadership.

- Forecast and explain the net revenue and the credit economics of each product, from net interest income, funding cost, interchange, and fees to delinquency, provisioning, and loss, so that revenue and credit views reconcile into a single, defensible view of profitability.

Project Manager - Law Clerk I
Remote, United States (On-site)
Job Title: Project Manager - Law Clerk I
Location: Remote
Position Summary:
The Project Manager - Law Clerk I serves as the main point of contact for contractor and Government personnel supporting the U.S. Attorney’s Office (USAO), District of New Jersey. This position assigns contractor taskings, manages subordinate staff time, and performs all Law Clerk I duties. The work supports USAO criminal and civil cases and related legal programs. This position does not appear in court to represent the United States.
Compensation & Benefits:
Starting Salary Range for Project Manager - Law Clerk I: Pay commensurate with experience.
Benefits That Set Us Apart
When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.
Highlights include:

• Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security

• Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage

• Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options

• Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays
•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options

• Professional development, training, and certification support

• Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.
Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.
Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:
Includes the following:

• Serve as the main point of contact for contractor and Government personnel.

•Assign all contractor taskings.

• Manage subordinate staff time, including leave, personal days, and administrative absences, and communicate that information to the Government point of contact in the staff members’ assigned district or districts.

• Work with assigned Attorney Advisors and supervisory attorneys to identify applicable administrative, statutory, and regulatory law and possible defenses, violations, or causes of action.

• Analyze policies, programs, legislative and regulatory initiatives, and case-related information.

• Prepare written work products that define legal issues, analyze applicable guidance, and make recommendations.

• Assist with reviewing, supporting, and implementing policies and guidelines for USAO programs, processes, and requirements.

• Monitor applicable federal, state, and local law and new criminal and civil rules and procedures.

• Alert Attorney Advisors to potential issues.

• Support case and program work involving immigration, civil and criminal matters, violent crime, fraud, human trafficking, drugs, and other program areas.

• Receive and docket matters; calendar and track due dates; and coordinate with Attorney Advisors and support staff to locate relevant files, data, and information.

• Draft legal memoranda, briefs, responses, correspondence, and legal documents for attorney review or signature.

• Analyze statutes, legislative intent, judicial precedents, agency rules and regulations, and law review articles, including for complex or unprecedented assignments.

• Brief attorneys on pertinent facts, issues, and case law.

• Protect confidential information and comply with the SOW’s restrictions on disclosure and use of artificial intelligence systems.

• Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
Supervisory and management responsibilities

• Manages subordinate staff time and assigns all contractor taskings.
